note: Schema documents describe the authoring contract. They are documentation: the loader skips content/schemas/ and they do not affect the catalog hash.

units.power: integer power-unit milli-units; power is never a stored commodity
units.no_floating_point: the loader rejects fractional and exponent literals outright

identifiers: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore; 1..64 characters

factions[].industry_throughput_bp: applies to Industry-category recipes; inputs, power and outputs rise together
factions[].clinic_capacity_bp: applied after staffing and power limits
factions[].fixture_only: a verification profile with no modifiers at all; a host must not offer it as playable

policies[].is_default: exactly one policy must set this
policies[].stability_target_adjust_bp: signed basis points added to the stability target
policies[].fatigue_delta_per_day: signed daily fatigue movement; negative is recovery
policies[].min_days: affected daily steps before the policy may be replaced
policies[].cooldown_days: days after ending before it may be reapplied
policies[].adherence_on_entry: map of faction id to a one-time adherence change
